what: Rule 16's banded age baseline, fitted. NOT a published specification: section 5's out-of-sample age-band criterion, which is what rule 16 says admits the form, has not been measured on it.
the_refusal_that_was_withdrawn: On 29 October 2026 this fit was refused as violating rule 16's monotonicity condition. The refusal was withdrawn on 30 October. episode_hazards (models/aft.py:492-493) takes its increment at FIXED covariates -- H(a+1 | x_a) - H(a | x_a) = exp(-rho*eta_a) * ((a+1)**rho - a**rho) -- and both factors are positive, so the monthly hazard is non-negative for every eta profile. The quantity that fell was H(a | eta_b) against H(a | eta_b+1): two covariate vectors at one age, which is two loans and not one loan's curve. Rule 16's condition is withdrawn, not reworded.

fit.formula: C(credit_score, Treatment(790.0)) + C(original_ltv, Treatment(50.0)) + C(debt_to_income, Treatment(19.0)) + term_years + moratorium_regime + C(age_band, Treatment(0.0)) + ltv_change + unemployment_change + financial_conditions + consumer_sentiment + C(purpose, Treatment('purchase')) + C(occupancy, Treatment('owner_occupied')) + C(harp, Treatment('standard')) + C(mortgage_insurance, Treatment('uninsured')) + C(buyer_type, Treatment('repeat'))
fit.ancillary: term_years + C(credit_score, Treatment(790.0)) + C(original_ltv, Treatment(50.0)) + C(debt_to_income, Treatment(19.0)) + C(purpose, Treatment('purchase')) + C(occupancy, Treatment('owner_occupied')) + C(harp, Treatment('standard')) + C(mortgage_insurance, Treatment('uninsured')) + C(buyer_type, Treatment('repeat'))

implied_monthly_hazard_at_the_reference_.note: Through episode_hazards on the fitted model, ages 0 to 359, every other covariate at its reference level. Per 100,000 loan-months a month.

what_is_true_about_the_form: The hazard is discontinuous in age: 23.775 per 100,000 at age 35 against 17.398 at 36, and 33.264 at 59 against 20.629 at 60. Positive and the cumulative hazard rises; not continuous, so a term structure built from it has kinks at six ages a reporting grouper chose. That prefers a smooth basis on grounds of smoothness, which decides a tie rather than refusing a form.
what_is_owed: Section 5's out-of-sample age-band criterion, anchored, on the declared test window, by the backtest_by_age_band view. Until then publishing this form and refusing it are both unjustified, so config stays at the published specification.
prediction_registered_24_october_still_o: 5 of 7 age bands or better out of sample, with the remaining miss above 60 months. Neither falsified nor confirmed: not measured.
also_found: buyer_type survives this selection where it was eliminated at step 7 on p = 0.177, with six eliminations instead of seven -- a first-time-buyer indicator standing in for the age profile until the age had its own coefficients.
